name: Maya Liu
bio: 8 years editing. Ex-Vox. Recent reels for B2B SaaS launches in the Linear/Apple lane. Strong with calm pacing, big type, and minimal transitions. Partners with an in-house composer for sound design.
portfolio_summary: Cut launch films for Notion competitors, a Series A AI infra startup, and a Brooklyn architecture firm. Delivered 90-sec hero films from 30+ min raw footage.

name: Priya Menon
bio: 7 years React, ex-Linear. Ships clean Tailwind + shadcn work with strong design sense. IST-based, comfortable in EU overlap. Prefers 2–6 week project sprints over long retainers.
portfolio_summary: Built marketing sites for a fintech (Stripe-style), a developer tools SaaS, and an AI consumer app. Lighthouse 95+ on every ship.

name: Aria Singh
bio: 8 years Swift + SwiftUI, ex-Apple Maps team. Loves animation-heavy consumer apps. Has shipped three V1 apps in the last 18 months on 6–8 week timelines.
portfolio_summary: Wrote the prototype Maps overlay for a small Apple subteam, then shipped a meditation app, a notes app, and a fitness tracker as a freelancer.

name: Sarah Chen
bio: Ex-Stripe brand designer, 6 yrs decks and brand identity. Specializes in confident, minimal Series A pitch decks and full brand systems for fintech and SaaS founders.
portfolio_summary: Built brand identity for two YC fintech companies, a creator economy startup, and several Series A pitch decks that closed.

name: Nathan Park
bio: Ex-Mailchimp and Notion brand copy lead. 5 years on SaaS landing pages. Specializes in capturing founder voice and turning it into conversion-focused copy without sounding corporate.
portfolio_summary: Wrote landing pages for a dev tools company, a productivity app, and three early-stage AI startups. All shipped, several with 2-3x conversion lifts.

name: Jordan Kim
bio: Brooklyn-based motion designer, 6 years across After Effects and Cinema 4D. Strong with product UI motion (the kind Linear and Stripe ship). Delivers Lottie files for engineers.
portfolio_summary: Animated launch videos for two design tool startups and a fintech. Delivered Lottie files for several SaaS product walkthroughs.

name: Riya Kapoor
bio: 8 years in UX, last 4 leading design at a B2B analytics company. Specializes in data-dense dashboards and turning messy enterprise UIs into something founders are proud to ship.
portfolio_summary: Redesigned the dashboard for an observability SaaS (35% increase in DAU), shipped a design system for a Series B fintech, and audited UX for two YC companies.

name: Devon Cruz
bio: 4 years on Webflow + GSAP, ex-MemberStack. Builds CMS-driven marketing sites for early-stage startups. Fast turnaround, low fuss, comfortable handing off to an in-house dev.
portfolio_summary: Shipped 12+ marketing sites in the last year, including for an AI agent startup and two creator-economy tools. Specializes in scroll-driven storytelling.

name: Leo Tanaka
bio: 7 years C4D + Octane, ex-Apple Industrial Design contractor. Photorealistic product renders for hardware launches and high-end marketing. Hard surface specialist.
portfolio_summary: Rendered marketing visuals for two consumer hardware launches, a luxury watch brand, and a clean-energy product company. Pixel-perfect product comp work.

name: Imani Bell
bio: 6 years editorial. Ex-The Verge contract illustrator. Style is friendly and modern — somewhere between New Yorker and Notion. Strong on weekly/series work and product illustration sets.
portfolio_summary: Weekly editorial for a fintech blog, illustration set for a productivity app's onboarding, and recurring covers for a tech publication.

name: Marcus Reyes
bio: 9 years backend. Built infra for a Series B fintech and two YC companies. Loves greenfield API design and getting an MVP backend shipped in a sprint.
portfolio_summary: Wrote the auth + payments backend for a Series A creator tool. Designed a tRPC API for a developer SaaS. Set up event ingestion for an analytics startup.

name: Hana Park
bio: 10 years commercial photography. SF/LA based, can travel. Specializes in clean product photography and warm founder/team portraits for brand sites.
portfolio_summary: Product shoots for two consumer hardware brands, founder portraits for a fintech (used on their Series A site), and brand campaigns for a wellness DTC.

name: Tomas Eriksson
bio: 6 years full-stack. Specializes in 4-8 week MVP builds for non-technical founders. Vercel + Supabase + Stripe as default stack. Ships fast and writes clean handoff docs.
portfolio_summary: Shipped MVPs for 5 startups in the last year — a B2B marketplace, a creator subscription tool, an AI productivity app, a fintech onboarding flow, and a community platform.

name: Isaac Reyes
bio: 10 years VO including credits at NPR and Headspace. Warm, conversational delivery. Owns a treated home studio and turns around 90-sec product narration in 24 hours.
portfolio_summary: Narrated launch films for a meditation app, a productivity SaaS, and a fintech. Recurring voice for a podcast network.

name: Yuki Tanaka
bio: 7 years product design, specialized in consumer mobile (mostly iOS-first). Has shipped 0-to-1 designs for three apps that hit App Store features. Strong native iOS feel.
portfolio_summary: Designed a meditation app, a notes app, and a kids' education app — all featured by Apple. Ships designs that engineers can build without back-and-forth.

name: Olivia Martin
bio: Content lead at a Series B dev tools company before going freelance 2 years ago. Specializes in B2B SaaS thought leadership and SEO content for developer audiences. No fluff, real opinions.
portfolio_summary: Built and ran content programs for two Series A startups. Wrote 50+ long-form pieces ranked top 3 for high-intent keywords.

name: Rohan Mehta
bio: 8 years infra/DevOps. Sets up production-ready Kubernetes + Terraform + observability for early-stage teams in 2-3 weeks. Strong on cost optimization.
portfolio_summary: Migrated three startups from Heroku/Vercel to Kubernetes on AWS. Set up observability stacks (Datadog, Grafana) for a fintech and an analytics SaaS.

name: Eli Tan
bio: 5 years 2D animation. Charming, playful style — think Duolingo or Headspace. Specializes in character-driven explainer videos and expressive brand motion.
portfolio_summary: Animated explainer videos for a kids' learning app, a wellness brand, and a creator economy startup. Did the brand mascot for a fintech onboarding flow.

name: Sofia Garcia
bio: 6 years on lifecycle email and email design. Klaviyo and Customer.io expert. Specializes in onboarding sequences that don't feel like marketing emails.
portfolio_summary: Designed and built lifecycle programs for a DTC skincare brand, a B2B SaaS, and a meditation app. 30%+ open rates on cold sequences.

name: Kai Mueller
bio: 7 years in ML, last 2 building LLM-powered backends. Ships RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, and eval harnesses for production AI features. Comfortable with LangChain, LangGraph, and bare-metal Python.
portfolio_summary: Built RAG backends for a legal tech startup, a customer support tool, and an internal-search SaaS. Set up eval pipelines for two LLM products in production.
